## Activity

River Outreach completed 55 captures during February 2026. This represents the recorded activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. The service continued to process captured images through the usual workflow, with each capture reviewed for suitability before grading.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.5 per cent. These results indicate that most captures were suitable for review, although the ungradable images should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality assurance. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 13 referable results from the February 2026 activity. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 day. This provides an overview of the time taken for images to move through the grading process during the reporting period. The activity, image-quality, and grading measures should be reviewed together to support ongoing monitoring of service performance at River Outreach.
